name: Windswept Farm Summer Riding Camp
description_short: Weekly summer riding camps at Windswept Farm, a boarding and lesson farm in Warren, RI, for riders aged 7 and older of all levels. Each day includes a riding lesson tailored to the camper's level plus unmounted lessons on horse care, equipment, basic horse first aid and riding disciplines.
